channel.title: The Local France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Local France (thelocal.fr)

item.title: France tightens infant formula rules after toxin scare
item.description: France plans to impose stricter limits on the acceptable level of a toxin called cereulide in infant formula after potentially contaminated products were recalled over 60 countries.

item.title: Thousands rally in France in support of cash-strapped police
item.description: Thousands of protesters including far-right politicians rallied across France on Saturday in support of the country's cash-strapped police force, with some of the demonstrators launching smoke bombs and blowing whistles.

item.title: On the Agenda: What’s happening in France this week
item.description: Pancake day, important dates for voters, the end of the winter sales, the start of the 2026 Six Nations and the Winter Olympics, and the first wave of the winter holidays.

item.title: French Phrase of the Day: À fleur de peau
item.description: Having 'flower skin' in French may sound like a compliment, but in reality it is not very flattering.

item.title: Speeding, French moving admin and pancakes: 6 essential articles for life in France
item.description: What you need to know about France’s speeding laws, a checklist for the increasing number of Americans planning to move to France, whether children of British citizens born here need a UK passport — and Chandeleur traditions.

item.title: 15 French replacements for American tech
item.description: From music streaming to cloud storage, via search engines and gaming, there exist plenty of French alternatives to the big American tech giants.

item.title: Everything that changes in France in February 2026
item.description: From decreasing electricity and gas prices to the famous French crêpes day and the country's biggest farm show, here is what is on the agenda for February 2026 in France.

item.title: French IT giant Capgemini to sell US subsidiary after row over ICE links
item.description: French IT giant Capgemini said on Sunday it was selling its subsidiary working for the US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agency amid international controversy over the deaths of two people in ICE operations.

item.title: French island offers up to €10,000 to second-home owners who rent out their property
item.description: Local officials on a French island are offering incentives of up to €10,000 to second-home owners who are willing to rent out their properties on a long-term lease, in order to try and overcome the housing shortage for locals.

item.title: Brits now fifth largest immigrant group in France
item.description: New data from the French government shows that British nationals now make up the fifth largest group of foreign residency-permit holders in France.
